faqs.question: Which is better: Old Tax Regime or New Tax Regime?
faqs.answer: It depends on your eligible deductions. If your total deductions (80C, 80D, HRA, Home Loan) exceed ₹3.75 - ₹4 Lakhs, the Old Regime may be beneficial. Otherwise, the New Regime with lower slab rates and ₹75,000 standard deduction is typically better. Use our interactive Tax Calculator to compare instantly!

faqs.question: What happens if I miss the ITR filing deadline?
faqs.answer: Filing after the July 31 deadline attracts a late filing penalty under Section 234F (up to ₹5,000) and interest of 1% per month under Section 234A on any unpaid tax liability.

faqs.question: What is the turnover threshold for mandatory GST registration?
faqs.answer: In India, GST registration is mandatory for businesses supplying goods with annual turnover exceeding ₹40 Lakhs (₹20 Lakhs for Special Category States), and for service providers exceeding ₹20 Lakhs (₹10 Lakhs in Special Category States). It is also mandatory for e-commerce sellers and interstate suppliers regardless of turnover.

faqs.question: What is GSTR-2B and why is it important?
faqs.answer: GSTR-2B is an auto-drafted Input Tax Credit (ITC) statement generated on the 14th of every month based on your suppliers' filings. By law, you can only claim ITC that appears in your GSTR-2B.

faqs.question: How much capital is required to start a Private Limited Company?
faqs.answer: There is no minimum paid-up capital requirement under the Companies Act. You can start with an authorized capital of ₹1,00,000 and paid-up capital as low as ₹1,000.

faqs.question: How long does company registration take in India?

faqs.question: What is the penalty for filing AOC-4 and MGT-7 late?
faqs.answer: Under the Companies Act, the late fee is ₹100 per day per form starting from the due date, with no maximum ceiling.

faqs.question: What is DIR-3 KYC and who must file it?
faqs.answer: Every individual who holds a Director Identification Number (DIN) as of March 31 must file DIR-3 KYC annually before September 30, even if they are not currently a director in any active company.
